Pulse 0.13.0

What's new:
- A first-run welcome. On its very first launch Pulse now presents its floating window instead of only adding an icon to the menu bar, and launching the already-running app from Applications brings that window back — an accessory app no longer answers with silence.
- A short guided tour for new users: three bubbles walk through adding the first symbol via search, opening its detail page, and switching the chart to daily candles. Every step can be done by hand or by clicking Next, and the whole tour is skippable at any point. Back on the list, a one-time tip shows how the pin tucks Pulse into the menu bar. Existing installs never see any of it, and finishing or skipping retires it for good.
- The empty watchlist's hint is now an actual button that opens search in place.
- The installer disk image opens onto a proper install window: branded background, Pulse on the left, Applications on the right, an arrow in between.

No setup or account changes are required after updating.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.13.0.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
